stageLabel: Ciyaarta adduunka furan. Jilaha ku wareeji. Fikradaha ayaa su'aalo kuu weydiin doona.

hintKeys: Fallaadhaha ama WASD si aad u socotid. N gurigga xiga.
guideText: Wareeg. Fikradaha ayaa ku heli doona, ama garaac guri xidhan si aad mid ula kulanto.
